about: Castlegar is a city in British Columbia’s West Kootenay, at the confluence of the Columbia and Kootenay rivers. A Doukhobor settlement heritage, Selkirk College, a regional airport, and a mill-and-highway service role define the community. About 8,000 people live in Castlegar.
seoSummary: West Kootenay city at the Columbia—Kootenay confluence—Doukhobor heritage, college, and river-valley hub.
